_comment: A Google OAuth client that is not one. It exists so the suite can drive the browser half of the authorization — the gate offering it, the panel saying an authorization is open, cancelling it — without a real client, a real account or a network. KIAO_WORKER_MOUNTS_GOOGLE_ENDPOINTS in bin/start-env.sh points the three Google endpoints somewhere harmless on the app's own origin, so the tab that opens lands nowhere in particular instead of at accounts.google.com.
